items.title: ORAN-DEFEND: Subspace Detection and Sanitization of Backdoor DRL xApps in Open RAN
items.summary: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) increasingly delegate near-real-time control to deep reinforcement learning (DRL) xApps obtained from third-party vendors, creating a new supply-chain attack surface. A backdoor policy behaves optimally until an adversary injects a covert trigger into the observed key performance indicator (KPI) telemetry, at which point it issues harmful control actions that degrade quality of service (QoS). We present ORAN-DEFEND, a retraining-free wrapper that sanitizes a frozen, potentially compromised xApp by projecting each KPI window onto a safe subspace estimated from a small number of trusted clean rollouts via singular value decomposition (SVD). We establish, both analytically and empirically, a precise recovery condition: the defense succeeds if the trigger energy concentrates in the orthogonal complement of the safe subspace, and we quantify this boundary through the trigger's $\Eperp$ energy fraction. On the Colosseum COLORAN dataset, we evaluate four structurally distinct DRL backdoor attacks, like TrojDRL, SleeperNets, BadRL, and Q-Incept, spanning inner-loop and outer-loop poisoning regimes and demonstrate $100\%$ return recovery and $\geq99.5\%$ defense success rate across all four when the subspace assumption holds. A geometry ablation reveals an intrinsic and previously uncharacterized limit of any linear projection defense: when the trigger collocates with the legitimate signal, the $\Eperp$ energy fraction governs recovery monotonically, and the linear residual detector collapses to chance even while a nonlinear classifier retains perfect separability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中第三方提供的深度强化学习（DRL）xApp所带来的供应链攻击面问题，提出了一种名为ORAN-DEFEND的防御框架。O-RAN将近实时控制权委托给由第三方供应商开发的DRL xApp，攻击者可能通过后门植入恶意策略：在正常条件下，xApp表现最优；但当攻击者在关键性能指标（KPI）遥测流中注入隐蔽的触发信号时，xApp会输出有害的控制动作，降低服务质量（QoS）。ORAN-DEFEND是一种无需重新训练的包装器，它通过将每个KPI窗口投影到由少量可信的干净轨迹通过奇异值分解（SVD）估计的安全子空间上，来对冻结的、可能被攻陷的xApp进行净化。作者在理论上和实验上建立了精确的恢复条件：如果触发能量集中在安全子空间的正交补空间中，则防御成功，并通过触发器的正交补空间能量分数定量刻画了这一边界。在Colosseum COLORAN数据集上，评估了四种结构不同的DRL后门攻击（包括TrojDRL、SleeperNets、BadRL和Q-Incept），覆盖了内循环和外循环投毒策略。实验表明，当子空间假设成立时，四种攻击均能达到100%的回报恢复率和超过99.5%的防御成功率。几何消融实验揭示了任何线性投影防御的一个内在且此前未被表征的极限：当触发器与合法信号共置时，正交补空间能量分数单调地决定恢复效果，线性残差检测器退化至随机猜测，而非线性分类器仍能保持完美可分性。该工作为O-RAN环境下基于DRL的xApp后门防御提供了理论分析和实用方法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: O-RAN架构引入了第三方xApp的供应链安全风险，本文首次提出了无需重新训练即可净化后门DRL xApp的实用方法，并给出了完整的理论边界和实验验证，对于保障开放网络的可靠性和安全性具有重要参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: KPI遥测窗口中异常的能量分布（正交补空间能量分数偏高）
经过投影后智能体决策与原始动作偏差较大
defense_advice_zh: 部署ORAN-DEFEND作为xApp的包装器，在运行时对KPI窗口进行子空间投影
建立少量可信的干净基线轨迹用于安全子空间估计
监控触发能量的正交补空间分数，设置阈值触发告警

items.title: Bit2Watt: A Cyber-Physical Vulnerability Exploiting GPU Workloads Across Power and Computing Infrastructures
items.summary: Modern data centers increasingly rely on large-scale GPU clusters and on-site renewable energy resources, resulting in a tightly coupled cyber-physical system between computing workloads and power-electronic-dominated grids. In this paper, we reveal Bit2Watt, a previously unexplored vulnerability in which an adversary manipulates GPU workloads to induce controlled, high-frequency power modulations that destabilize local power infrastructure and propagate back to disrupt computing services. Unlike traditional attacks that compromise grid-side devices or communication channels, Bit2Watt operates entirely within the cyber layer as a legal tenant, which could amplify fluctuations, harmonic distortion, and damping degradation, particularly in high-DER-penetration scenarios. This risk is difficult to detect under routine cloud- and facility-side monitoring because it exploits legitimate workload execution paths and concentrates much of its distinctive behavior in high-frequency components that are weakly captured by common telemetry. We validate Bit2Watt through impedance-based analysis, power system simulations, and real-world experiments on GPUs and grid-connected PV inverters. Under the synchronized worst-case aggregation model studied in the paper, manipulating 1,000 GPUs in a 1-MW local power system with 90% DERs raises current THD to 46.8% and results in a damping ratio of -0.27. We further show that the resulting power-quality degradation can stress data-center power-delivery equipment, trigger protection mechanisms, and, in extreme simulated cases, induce cascading failures in transmission-scale systems. In addition, we analyze a plausible Watt2Bit feedback path, including denial-of-service risks and covert information exfiltration via EMI side channels. This work highlights the urgent need for cross-layer defenses that jointly consider workload scheduling and power electronics.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文揭示了一种名为 Bit2Watt 的新型网络物理漏洞。在现代数据中心中，大规模 GPU 集群与现场可再生能源深度融合，形成了计算负载与电力电子主导电网之间的紧密耦合网络物理系统。Bit2Watt 允许攻击者仅通过操纵 GPU 工作负载（例如恶意编排计算任务），在不直接攻击电网侧设备或通信链路的情况下，诱导产生受控的高频功率调制。这种调制会破坏本地电力基础设施的稳定性，并通过反馈路径反向影响计算服务的正常运行。攻击完全在 cyber 层以合法租户身份执行，因此难以被传统的云侧或设施侧监控手段察觉。通过基于阻抗的分析、电力系统仿真以及 GPU 与并网光伏逆变器的真实实验，作者验证了该漏洞的有效性。在同步最坏情况聚合模型下，对一个含 90% 分布式能源（DER）的 1 MW 本地电力系统操纵 1000 块 GPU，可使电流总谐波失真（THD）升至 46.8%，阻尼比降至 -0.27，系统呈现负阻尼状态。这种电能质量恶化会进一步加大对数据中心配电设备的压力，触发保护机制，在极端仿真场景下甚至可能导致跨传输级系统的级联故障。此外，文章还分析了潜在的 Watt2Bit 反馈路径，包括拒绝服务风险以及通过电磁干扰侧信道进行隐蔽信息窃取。该研究强调了亟需跨层防御机制，将工作负载调度与电力电子设计联合考虑。本文适合数据中心运维人员、电力系统安全研究者、GPU 集群管理者以及关注基础设施安全跨域攻击的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示通过纯软件方式（GPU 工作负载）操纵电网电能质量的新型攻击面，颠覆了传统认知——攻击者无需接触电网即可引发物理级联故障。该漏洞难以检测且影响范围大，对数据中心弹性构成实质性威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响采用 GPU 集群与高比例可再生能源的数据中心电力基础设施，导致谐波失真、系统失稳、设备保护触发甚至级联断电；也能反向通过电力扰动造成计算服务中断（DoS），或利用 EMI 侧信道泄露信息。

defense_advice_zh: 实施跨层监控，将 GPU 工作负载统计与电力质量指标（如 THD、阻尼比）关联
在调度策略中引入电力约束，避免形成同步高负载模式

items.title: Untrusted Content Masking for Web Agents with Security Guarantees
items.summary: Defenses that provide security guarantees against prompt injection attacks rely on strict isolation between trusted instructions and untrusted data. In text-based environments such as tool-use APIs, this separation arises naturally: agents can reason from interface definitions without ever processing untrusted content. Extending these guarantees to web agents faces a fundamental challenge: to perceive and interact with their environment, web agents must first observe the rendered page, which intermingles trusted content with untrusted content. This structural entanglement removes the trust boundary on which security guarantees depend, undermining provable defenses for web agents. In this paper, we present Untrusted Content Masking (UCM), a simple and effective approach that restores this boundary in web environments. We leverage a key structural insight: a webpage's Document Object Model (DOM) encodes sufficient information to distinguish trusted from untrusted regions without reading their content. Our framework exploits this by redacting untrusted regions before they reach the agent and routing interaction through a sandboxed interface with strict privilege separation, thereby enabling agents to observe and interact with their environment while remaining isolated from adversarial content. The code is publicly available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对Web代理面临的提示注入攻击问题，提出了一种名为“不可信内容遮蔽”（Untrusted Content Masking, UCM）的防御方法。在基于文本的工具调用API等环境中，可信指令与不可信数据天然分离，代理可以基于接口定义进行推理而无需处理不可信内容，从而提供安全保障。然而，Web代理需要观察和交互渲染后的网页，其中可信与不可信内容混杂，导致信任边界消失，使得现有可证明的防御失效。UCM方法利用网页的文档对象模型（DOM）编码了足够的信息来区分可信与不可信区域，而无需读取其内容。通过在执行前遮蔽不可信区域，并通过具有严格权限隔离的沙箱接口路由交互，UCM恢复信任边界，使代理在观察和交互环境的同时与对抗性内容隔离。实验部分（摘要未详述，但论文代码已公开）验证了该方法的有效性。本文适合研究LLM安全、Web代理安全及提示注入防御的研究人员和工程师阅读。

items.title: Multi-Class vs. Multi-Label BERT for CVE-to-CWE Mapping: How Taxonomy Structure Shapes the Errors
items.summary: Assigning Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories to Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records remains an important but largely manual step in vulnerability analysis. We study this task as a text classification problem and compare two modelling choices: a \emph{multi-class} formulation that predicts a single CWE per CVE and a \emph{multi-label} formulation that allows multiple assignments. Three transformer encoders (BERT Base, SecureBERT, and CySecBERT) are evaluated on three nested label spaces (83, 47, and 25 classes). Multi-class training achieves higher macro-F1 across all settings, although the gap to multi-label narrows from 21 to 2 percentage points as the label space shrinks. Post-hoc threshold optimisation on the multi-label side closes this gap on the 25-class setting. Confusion analysis shows that the dominant misclassification patterns follow the CWE hierarchy and are shared across all three encoders (Pearson $r > 0.92$), which suggests that the error structure is driven more by taxonomy design than by encoder choice. A hierarchy-relaxed evaluation that forgives within-family confusions raises macro-F1 from ${\sim}$81\% to ${\sim}$90\%, indicating that strict metrics understate branch-level classifier quality. CySecBERT achieves the strongest results overall, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the multi-label setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦于CVE（通用漏洞披露）到CWE（通用弱点枚举）的自动分类任务，旨在减少人工标注成本。传统上CVE到CWE的映射依赖专家手动完成，效率低下且不一致。作者将问题建模为文本分类，系统比较了多类（每个CVE预测一个CWE）与多标签（允许预测多个CWE）两种范式。评估使用三个预训练Transformer模型（BERT Base、SecureBERT、CySecBERT）在三个嵌套标签空间（83、47、25个CWE类别）上进行。核心发现包括：1）多类训练在所有设置下取得更高的宏F1值，但随标签空间缩小，其相对优势从21个百分点降至2个百分点；2）通过后处理阈值优化，多标签模型在25类场景下可追平多类性能；3）错误混淆分析显示，主导性的误分类模式严格遵循CWE层次结构（如将特定类型错误归到父类），且这种模式在所有三个编码器间高度一致（Pearson r > 0.92），表明误差结构主要由分类法设计驱动而非模型选择；4）采用层次宽松评估（允许同一CWE家族内的错误）时，宏F1从约81%提升至约90%，说明严格指标低估了分支级分类器的实际质量。总体而言，CySecBERT在多标签设置中表现最优，且统计显著。该工作为实际部署CVE-CWE自动映射提供了方法论指导，强调在评估中应考虑分类法层次结构的影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CVE到CWE的自动映射是漏洞管理自动化的关键环节，直接影响威胁情报准确性和安全运营效率。该研究揭示了分类误差主要由层次结构决定而非模型，为优化标注流程和评估标准提供了可操作见解。

items.title: Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents
items.summary: Agentic red-teaming benchmarks report whether an injected agent was compromised as a single bit: the attack succeeded, or it did not. We argue that this binary attack-success rate discards the information a defender most needs, namely how harmful the resulting action was. We introduce an action-graded harm rubric that scores an agent's tool-call trajectory on a seven-level ordinal scale (L0 to L6) according to whether the executed action was reversible, whether it crossed scope to reach another party, and whether it expanded privilege. We compute the scale two ways: a deterministic oracle that reads the trajectory and the attacker's stated goal, and a panel of three frontier language-model judges that read a tag-free account of the same trajectory. Across four victim models and two defenses on the AgentDojo workspace suite, severity grading exposes three cases the binary metric hides, including a defense that reports a zero attack-success rate while still permitting an externally visible cross-scope leak through an unfiltered tool. The judge panel reproduces the oracle with high ordinal agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91) but shares systematic blind spots that we characterize, most notably a failure to recognize escalation chains. Unlike prior work that provides harm taxonomies, harmful-task completion tests, execution-level safety benchmarks, or severity-aware simulation, our contribution is a reusable, trace-grounded severity instrument applied to the actual actions recorded in existing red-team logs. All code, prompts, and per-episode logs are released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对当前工具型AI代理（agent）红队评测中普遍采用的二进制攻击成功率（attack-success rate）指标提出了质疑。作者指出，单一的“成功/失败”比特无法向防御者传达最关键的信息——即被入侵代理实际执行的行为到底造成了多大危害。为此，他们提出了一种基于动作分级（action-graded）的危害评估尺度（harm rubric），将代理的工具调用轨迹按照七个等级（L0至L6）进行排序。等级划分依据三个维度：执行的动作是否可逆、是否越界影响其他方、是否扩展了权限。作者通过两种方式计算该尺度：一是确定性预言机（oracle），解析轨迹并比对攻击者的明确目标；二是由三个前沿语言模型组成的评判小组，它们仅阅读无标签的轨迹描述。在AgentDojo工作空间套件上，作者对四个受害者模型和两种防御策略进行了测试，发现严重程度分级揭示了二进制指标所隐藏的三种情况，包括一种防御策略虽然报告零攻击成功率，但通过未过滤的工具仍然允许可见的外部越界泄露。评判小组与预言机相比，取得了高度的一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91），但存在系统性盲点，最明显的是未能识别权限提升链。与现有工作（危害分类、有害任务完成测试、执行级安全基准、严重程度感知模拟）不同，本文贡献了一个可复用、基于轨迹的严重程度评估工具，可直接应用于现有红队日志中的实际动作。所有代码、提示词和每轮日志均已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统二进制攻击成功率指标严重低估风险，该论文提出的多级严重程度尺度使防御者能精准识别代理行为的实际危害，尤其能发现看似“安全”的防御中隐藏的越界泄露。

items.title: FedCVESA: Taking Away Training Data in Federated Learning via Correlation Value Encoding and Segmented Aggregation
items.summary: Federated learning (FL) avoids explicit data exposure by keeping raw data on local clients, yet privacy risks remain in the training process and the learned model itself. Recently, centralized Taking Away Training Data (TATD) attacks have shown that malicious training could abuse the memorization capacity of deep models to store and later recover training data. However, this memorization-based threat has not been systematically studied under FL environments, where multi-client averaging could overwrite encoded training data. In this paper, we study a white-box TATD attack in which a malicious server selects n target clients from K participating clients and actively writes private training data into the global model during federated training. We propose FedCVESA, a federated variant of Correlation Value Encoding Attack (CVEA), by adding a Pearson-correlation regularizer to the loss function of target clients, so that private training data are gradually encoded into selected model parameters, referred to as carrier parameters. To reduce the overwriting of carrier parameters during server aggregation, we further propose segmented aggregation over dispersed carrier parameters, preserving selected carrier parameters while keeping standard averaging on the remaining parameters. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet non-IID partitions show that the proposed method can steal semantically meaningful private training images from the trained model while maintaining acceptable main-task utility in a controlled proof-of-concept setting. These results demonstrate that FL can become a parameter-level memorization channel for active TATD attack under the studied white-box malicious-server setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）通过将原始数据保留在本地客户端来避免显式数据暴露，但训练过程和模型本身仍存在隐私风险。近期，集中式“取走训练数据”（TATD）攻击表明，恶意训练可利用深度模型的记忆能力存储并恢复训练数据。然而，这种基于记忆的威胁在联邦学习环境下尚未得到系统研究，因为多客户端平均可能覆盖被编码的训练数据。本文研究白盒TATD攻击，恶意服务器从K个参与客户端中选择n个目标客户端，并在联邦训练期间主动将私有训练数据写入全局模型。作者提出FedCVESA，一种基于相关性值编码攻击（CVEA）的联邦变体，通过在目标客户端的损失函数中添加皮尔逊相关性正则化器，使得私有训练数据逐渐编码到选定的模型参数（即载体参数）中。为减少服务器聚合时对载体参数的覆盖，进一步提出对分散的载体参数进行分段聚合：保留选定的载体参数不变，而对剩余参数进行标准平均。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，基于Dirichlet非独立同分布划分的实验表明，该方法能从训练模型中窃取具有语义意义的私有训练图像，同时在受控的概念验证设置中保持可接受的主任务效用。这些结果证明，在所研究的白盒恶意服务器设定下，联邦学习可成为主动TATD攻击的参数级记忆通道。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了联邦学习场景中一种新型主动数据窃取攻击，表明即使不直接访问客户端数据，恶意服务器也能通过参数编码实质上盗取训练数据，对联邦学习的隐私保护构成新威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 联邦学习部署中，如果服务器不可信，则存在训练数据泄露风险；该攻击可泛化到其他基于参数平均的分布式学习场景。

items.title: Safe2Hail: A Forensic-Driven Post-Trip Tracking Framework for Ride-Hailing Safety in Africa
items.summary: Ride-hailing mobile apps have become an essential feature in the mobility ecosystem in Africa, offering much safer and much more affordable rides. Although user bases have increased and the number of daily trips has proliferated, reports of imminent safety threats, particularly after the cancellation of the ride or the ride is prematurely terminated, remain unresolved challenges. Current safety measures offer features such as SOS alerts, safety notifications, and live location sharing for the duration of the trip, but they are not in place when the trip is over. Safe2Hail presents a framework that is forensically driven to ensure continuous safety and certainty beyond the trip. The Safe2Hail framework combines forensic tracking with a temporary post-trip synchronization mechanism that can securely log all proximal data between a passenger and a driver after an event. The Safe2Hail framework was beta-tested and demonstrates the effectiveness of the system. Although the research team did not pilot on actual deployment, the Safe2Hail design format was in part inspired by actual crime events reported in Nairobi and Dar-es-Salaam. The findings of the study referenced Safe2Hail's feasibility, light weight nature of resources, as well as the scalability for the framework.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 Safe2Hail 框架，针对非洲网约车行业在行程结束后缺乏安全监控的问题。当前大多数网约车应用仅在行程中提供 SOS 警报、安全通知和实时位置共享，但行程取消或提前终止后，乘客和司机便失去安全保障。Safe2Hail 结合数字取证与临时后行程同步机制，在事件发生后安全地记录乘客与司机之间的所有近程数据，从而提供持续的追踪能力。框架设计灵感来源于内罗毕和达累斯萨拉姆的实际犯罪事件，经过 beta 测试验证了其有效性、资源轻量性和可扩展性。论文重点在于提出一种可扩展的、取证驱动的后行程安全解决方案，适用于资源受限的环境。

items.title: Finding and Understanding Miscompilation Bugs in the Solidity Compiler
items.summary: Smart contract compilers are critical to ensuring the correctness of public blockchains whose defining characteristics are open-source and immutable code. We created SolSmith, a semantics-aware differential fuzz testing tool, to improve the quality of the Solidity compiler -- the most popular compiler for the Ethereum blockchain -- and spent over three years finding compiler defects that produce incorrect code. We call these defects miscompilation bugs. During this time period, we have discovered 25 miscompilation bugs that went unnoticed, some for multiple years. Our first contribution is to make compiler testing more rigorous. SolSmith achieves this goal by generating valid test programs that are likely to stress test code generation and optimization components. This helps SolSmith find bugs missed during routine testing that could potentially have serious implications for smart contracts and their users. Our second contribution is a qualitative and quantitative analysis of miscompilation bugs that we found in the Solidity compiler. We classify miscompilation bugs found by SolSmith based on their nature, root-causes, and impact on end-users. This sheds light on some pitfalls of optimizing compilers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对Solidity编译器中存在的误编译（miscompilation）漏洞进行了系统的发现与分析。Solidity是以太坊区块链上最流行的智能合约语言，其编译器的正确性直接关系到链上代码的不可篡改性和安全性。作者设计并实现了SolSmith——一个基于语义感知的差异模糊测试工具，用于自动化检测Solidity编译器在代码生成和优化阶段产生的错误。SolSmith通过生成语义等价但语法多变的测试程序，有效触发了编译器内部路径，从而揭露了常规测试难以发现的缺陷。在超过三年的持续测试中，SolSmith共发现25个此前未知的误编译bug，部分bug已存在多年。论文的贡献包括：1）提出了更严格的编译器测试方法，通过语义等价变异和增量式测试生成，提高了对代码生成和优化组件的压力测试能力；2）对这些误编译bug进行了定性和定量分析，按性质、根本原因和对最终用户的影响进行了分类，揭示了优化编译器的一些常见陷阱。分析表明，这些bug可能导致生成的字节码与源代码语义不一致，进而引发智能合约逻辑错误、资产损失或安全漏洞。本文适合编译器开发者、区块链安全研究员以及智能合约审计人员阅读，以了解Solidity编译器的潜在风险和改进方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能合约编译器是区块链安全的关键基础设施，任何误编译bug都可能导致严重的经济损失。本文首次系统性地揭示了Solidity编译器的长期隐藏缺陷，为提升编译器可靠性提供了方法论和实证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有使用Solidity编译器的智能合约开发者；发现的25个bug可能影响历史合约的正确性；方法论可迁移至其他区块链编译器（如Vyper）的检测。

items.title: Evaluating Endpoint Detection Robustness Against Genetic Algorithm Driven Code Transformations
items.summary: Post-compromise test variants are widely used in controlled security evaluation and endpoint robustness benchmarking. However, modern Antivirus (AV) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) systems increasingly combine signature- and behavior-based detection, challenging the reliability of conventional detection pipelines under adaptive variation. This study introduces ShellForge, a Genetic Algorithm (GA)-driven framework that evolves post-compromise variants representative of remote command execution to generate functionally equivalent variants for systematic detection evaluation. ShellForge applies syntactic transformations, encoding schemes, and structural permutations guided by a multi-objective fitness function informed by AV and EDR detection feedback. We compare ShellForge against representative baseline transformation frameworks under identical sandbox configurations. Our findings highlight measurable robustness gaps in baseline signature- and behavior-oriented detection pipelines under controlled variant generation. In addition, we propose a reproducible benchmark for endpoint detection robustness evaluation, motivating the need for robustness-aware defensive monitoring and behavioral correlation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 ShellForge 的遗传算法驱动框架，用于生成后渗透测试变种，以系统评估端点检测系统（AV/EDR）的鲁棒性。当前 AV 和 EDR 系统结合了签名和基于行为的检测，但在面对适应性变种时可靠性不足。ShellForge 以远程命令执行的后渗透变种为基线，通过遗传算法应用句法变换、编码方案和结构置换，利用多目标适应度函数（结合 AV/EDR 检测反馈）指导进化，生成功能等价但形态不同的变种。在相同沙箱配置下，对比了若干基线变换框架，实验揭示了现有签名和基于行为的检测流水线在受控变种生成下的显著鲁棒性差距。论文还提出了一种可复现的端点检测鲁棒性基准测试方法，为防御监控和行为关联的鲁棒性感知提供了必要性。该研究主要贡献在于：1) 提出了 GA 驱动框架自动生成检测逃逸变种；2) 量化了主流 EDR 产品的检测盲区；3) 建立了标准化的鲁棒性评估基准。适合安全防御研究人员、EDR 开发者和渗透测试人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前端点检测系统在面对自动化变种生成时的脆弱性，为EDR/AV厂商改进检测算法和防御团队设计鲁棒性监控策略提供了可复现的评估方法。

items.title: Certifying Ghosts: How Cybersecurity AI Agents Break the EU Cyber Resilience Act
items.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) makes a smart bet. It does not demand that products be free of vulnerabilities, but only that manufacturers run a process: assess risk, handle flaws, ship updates. The bet pays off if four things about the world stay true: (P1) finding vulnerabilities is slow, skilled, human work; (P2) a product's exploitable flaws are knowable the day it ships; (P3) exploitation is rare enough to notice; and (P4) fixes keep pace with discovery. Cybersecurity AI (CAI) agents, AI put to work finding and exploiting flaws in other products, falsify all four. The regime answers in two opposite ways. Against the sheer volume of flaws that agents surface it bends (P1): built for scarce attention, it re-centres compliance on defensible, documented prioritisation, and holds. But agents also collapse the speed and economics of the vulnerability lifecycle, and here it breaks (P2, P3, P4): a product that passed every check becomes exploitable without anyone touching it, so its market-entry test, its reporting trigger, and its one-and-done certificate vouch for a security that has quietly expired. The fault is in the landscape, not the product, so running the process more diligently cannot repair it. We map each mechanism to the force that strains or snaps it, and find the cure and the disease cut from the same cloth: because defenders and attackers wield the same AI, the only conformity that survives is one that never stops running. We also carry the remedy from proposal to proof on two CRA-scope robots, a humanoid and a lawn mower, where an agentic defender holds a line their undefended selves cannot. On the evidence already in hand, the CRA reaches full force in December 2027 certifying products against a world that has already changed. Static, human-paced security is finished; what replaces it must be continuous and agent-operated, and that is no longer a matter of taste.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文分析了欧盟《网络弹性法案》（CRA）在面对网络安全AI代理（CAI代理）时的局限性。CRA的核心逻辑是要求制造商运行一个流程（风险评估、漏洞处理、更新发布），而非保证产品绝对无漏洞。该逻辑依赖于四项假设：（P1）发现漏洞是缓慢、需要熟练人工的工作；（P2）产品在出厂时的可利用漏洞是已知的；（P3）漏洞利用足够罕见以至于能够被注意到；（P4）修复速度与发现速度保持同步。然而，CAI代理能够自动寻找并利用其他产品中的漏洞，从而彻底颠覆了上述假设。面对CAI代理带来的海量漏洞，CRA在P1上通过将合规重点转向可辩护的、有文档记录的优先级排序得以勉强维持；但在漏洞生命周期的速度和经济学上（P2、P3、P4），CRA被彻底击穿：一个通过所有检查的产品，可能在无人修改的情况下变得可被利用，其市场准入测试、报告触发点和一次性认证证书所担保的安全性早已悄然失效。问题的根源在于环境变化而非产品本身，因此更勤奋地执行流程也无法修复。作者将每个机制映射到使其紧张或断裂的力量，并指出防御者和攻击者使用相同的AI，因此唯一能够存续的合规形式是永不停止的持续验证。作者还在两个CRA范围内的机器人（一个类人机器人和一个割草机）上将这一补救措施从提议推进到证明，展示了防御代理能够守住未防御者无法守住的防线。结论表明，静态、人工节奏的安全性已经结束，取而代之的必须是持续且由代理操作的安全，而这已不再是品味问题。

items.title: Cyber Dynamics I: Finite Macrostates for Behavioral Anomaly Detection in Network Telemetry
items.summary: Entropy-based methods have long been used for network anomaly detection, but most existing approaches treat entropy as a scalar statistic on narrow observables rather than as part of a broader behavioral state-space for cyber systems. We propose a finite-dimensional macrostate framework for network telemetry, instantiated over the Canonical Security Telemetry Substrate (CSTS), so that coarse-graining is performed over persistent entities, typed relations, and temporal state rather than isolated event records. The resulting macrostate captures activity, distributional disorder, structural organization, temporal volatility, persistence, and deviation from benign baselines. Rather than scoring only unusual states, we model window-to-window macrostate transitions and define regime structure, stability, and anomalous change. This supports discrimination between benign workload drift and adversarial reorganization. We evaluate the framework on benchmark network telemetry datasets and compare it against Shannon-, Rényi-, and Tsallis-style entropy baselines, as well as standard anomaly detectors. The proposed representation improves anomaly discrimination and supports more interpretable behavioral analysis of cyber telemetry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于有限维度宏状态（finite macrostates）的网络异常检测框架，用于分析网络遥测数据中的行为异常。传统基于熵的方法通常将熵视为窄观测上的标量统计量，而忽略了网络系统的整体行为状态空间。作者在规范安全遥测基板（CSTS）上实例化该框架，对持久实体、类型化关系和时序状态进行粗粒化处理，而不是孤立的事件记录。生成的宏状态捕获活动性、分布无序性、结构组织、时序波动性、持久性以及与良性基线的偏差。论文进一步建模窗口间宏状态转换，定义状态结构、稳定性和异常变化，从而区分良性工作负载漂移和对抗性重组。在基准网络遥测数据集上的评估表明，该表示方法在异常区分度上优于Shannon、Rényi和Tsallis熵基线以及标准异常检测器，并支持更可解释的遥测行为分析。核心贡献包括：提出宏状态框架、定义状态转换分析、以及通过实验证明其有效性。适合研究网络异常检测、行为分析和安全遥测的数据科学家和安全工程师阅读。

items.title: An Automated Framework for Generating Stealthy Cell-Embedded Hardware Trojans
items.summary: Hardware Trojans (HTs) pose significant threats across the Integrated Circuit (IC) design lifecycle because they can be inserted by untrusted entities at different stages under the zero-trust model. When triggered under rare conditions, HTs can compromise the functionality, reliability, or security of the fabricated chip. HT assessment is typically performed by modeling realistic Trojan insertion scenarios in RTL implementation or gate-level netlists. While this model is useful for evaluating detection methods, it does not capture attacks where malicious behavior is hidden inside standard-cell implementations from a compromised library supplied by an untrusted vendor. This paper presents a novel framework for automatically generating cell-embedded hardware Trojans using compromised standard-cell implementations. Our proposed framework analyzes a mapped design, identifies candidate cell instances with rare input conditions, and applies payload templates that corrupt the selected cell output only when the trigger condition is satisfied. Experiments on open-source combinational and sequential benchmark designs show that our proposed framework can generate valid and stealthy Trojan instances across different cell types and design sizes. The results highlight a critical gap in current Trojan detection assumptions and show the need for cell-aware validation of standard-cell implementations in zero-trust IC design flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 硬件木马（HT）在集成电路（IC）设计生命周期中构成重大威胁，因为不可信实体在零信任模型下可以在不同阶段插入HT。当在罕见条件下触发时，HT会损害芯片的功能、可靠性或安全性。传统的HT评估通常通过在RTL实现或门级网表中模拟真实的木马插入场景进行，但这种方法无法捕捉恶意行为隐藏在来自不可信供应商的受损标准单元库中的攻击。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，用于利用受损的标准单元实现自动生成单元嵌入的硬件木马。该框架分析映射后的设计，识别具有稀有输入条件的候选单元实例，并应用有效载荷模板，仅在触发条件满足时破坏选定单元的输出。在开源组合和时序基准设计上的实验表明，该框架能够在不同单元类型和设计规模下生成有效且隐秘的木马实例。结果凸显了当前木马检测假设中的关键空白，并表明在零信任IC设计流程中需要对标准单元实现进行单元感知验证。该研究对于硬件安全研究人员、IC设计验证工程师以及关注零信任供应链安全的从业者具有参考价值。

items.title: SA-DRL: Security-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Ransomware Detection with Asymmetric Reward Design
items.summary: Ransomware detection is a security-critical task in which false negatives and false positives have unequal operational consequences. Conventional machine learning detectors often use symmetric objectives that penalize missed ransomware detections and benign false alarms equally, although a false negative can cause irreversible encryption, operational disruption, and high recovery cost, whereas a false positive is usually reversible. This study proposes a Security-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning (SA-DRL) framework that embeds false-negative and false-positive cost asymmetry into the reinforcement learning reward signal to prioritize missed-detection reduction. The framework also introduces a Security-Optimal Model Selection (SOMS) criterion and an adaptive episode-level sample-ordering mechanism. Four deep reinforcement learning agents, DQN, DDQN, PPO, and A2C, were evaluated using a symmetric baseline reward (R1) and a security-aware asymmetric reward (R2). Experiments used four discount factors, five-fold cross-validation, and three random seeds, resulting in 480 training runs on a balanced ransomware detection dataset. The SOMS criterion selects models by prioritizing false-negative rate, followed by F1-score and training time. Results show that asymmetric reward shaping improves security-oriented detection performance. The SOMS-selected configuration, DDQN with R2 and gamma = 0.1, achieved a false-negative rate of 0.0080, an F1-score of 0.9915, and an AUC of 0.998, reducing missed detections by 67.6% compared with the best supervised baseline. Across all configurations, R2 reduced the mean false-negative rate by 43% relative to R1. These findings show that reward-function design is important for security-sensitive ransomware detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向勒索软件检测的安全感知深度强化学习（SA-DRL）框架。传统机器学习检测器通常使用对称目标函数，平等惩罚漏报和误报，但漏报会导致不可逆的加密、业务中断和高昂恢复成本，而误报通常可逆。SA-DRL通过将漏报和误报的成本不对称性嵌入强化学习奖励信号中，优先减少漏报。框架还引入了安全最优模型选择（SOMS）准则和自适应回合级样本排序机制。实验评估了四种深度强化学习智能体（DQN、DDQN、PPO、A2C），使用对称基线奖励（R1）和安全感知不对称奖励（R2）。在平衡的勒索软件检测数据集上，采用四个折扣因子、五折交叉验证和三个随机种子，共进行480次训练。SOMS准则通过优先考虑漏报率，然后是F1分数和训练时间来选择模型。结果表明，非对称奖励塑造提高了安全导向的检测性能。SOMS选择的配置（DDQN + R2 + gamma=0.1）实现了漏报率0.0080、F1分数0.9915、AUC 0.998，与最佳监督基线相比，漏报减少67.6%。在所有配置中，R2相比R1平均漏报率降低43%。这些发现表明奖励函数设计对安全敏感的勒索软件检测至关重要。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 勒索软件检测中漏报代价远高于误报，传统方法忽视这一不对称性。本文通过强化学习奖励设计直接优化安全目标，显著降低漏报率，为安全检测器开发提供新范式。

items.title: Auditable Machine Unlearning for Privacy-Compliant Ransomware Detection Using Multi-Shard SISA and Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Ransomware poses an escalating cybersecurity threat as attackers continuously modify behavioral patterns to evade static defenses. Although existing machine learning-based detectors often achieve strong predictive performance, they generally assume fixed training data and do not support the selective removal of previously learned samples. This limitation conflicts with privacy regulations such as the GDPR and CCPA, which require the removal of sensitive user data upon request. To address this challenge, we propose an auditable ransomware detection and unlearning framework that integrates deep reinforcement learning with multi-shard SISA retraining. In the proposed system, a Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) learns a reward-guided detection policy from behavioral features under asymmetric security costs, while multi-shard SISA enables privacy-compliant selective sample removal through shard-level retraining. The framework was evaluated using four criteria: utility preservation, oracle-based forgetting validation, membership inference auditing, and computational efficiency. On a balanced Windows 11 behavioral dataset comprising 2,000 samples and 103 features, the baseline DDQN detector achieved an F1 score of 0.9925 and an AUC of 0.9983. The experimental results show that single-shard unlearning maintains minimal utility degradation and low oracle disagreement, whereas moderate shard counts (M = 5-10) provide the best efficiency-performance trade-off, reducing retraining time to 5-30 s compared with 80-330 s for full retraining. In addition, the membership inference scores remain close to 0.5 across most configurations, indicating limited privacy leakage after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that a privacy-compliant ransomware detection framework can jointly achieve high detection performance, auditable deletion verification, and efficient sample removal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对勒索软件检测中的隐私合规问题，提出了一种可审计的机器学习遗忘框架。背景是：现有的基于机器学习的勒索软件检测器通常假设训练数据固定，不支持选择性删除已学习样本，这与GDPR、CCPA等隐私法规的用户数据删除权冲突。为此，作者将深度强化学习与多分片SISA（分片隔离、切片聚合）重训练相结合。系统使用双深度Q网络（DDQN）从行为特征中学习奖励导向的检测策略，并引入非对称安全成本；多分片SISA通过分片级重训练实现隐私合规的选择性样本移除。实验基于Windows 11行为数据集（2000样本，103特征），基线DDQN检测器F1分数0.9925，AUC 0.9983。遗忘机制评估了四个指标：效用保持、基于oracle的遗忘验证、成员推断审计和计算效率。结果表明，单分片遗忘保持最小效用下降和低oracle分歧；中等分片数（5-10）提供最佳效率-性能权衡，重训练时间从完全重训练的80-330秒降至5-30秒。成员推断分数大多接近0.5，表明遗忘后隐私泄露有限。该工作证明隐私合规的勒索软件检测框架可同时实现高检测性能、可审计删除验证和高效样本移除。适合从事隐私保护机器学习、安全检测、隐私合规的从业者和研究人员阅读。

items.title: Behavioral Privacy Leakage in Agentic Negotiation: Formalizing and Mitigating Inference Attacks via Randomized Policies
items.summary: Autonomous negotiation agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as insurance and procurement. While cryptographic techniques protect explicitly disclosed constraint values, they fail to address a subtler threat: behavioral privacy leakage, where an adversary infers private constraints from observable negotiation dynamics such as concession trajectories, timing, and convergence patterns. This paper investigates behavioral differential privacy in multi-round negotiation protocols. We design an adaptive stochastic negotiation policy that jointly guarantees $(\varepsilon, δ)$-differential privacy, almost-sure convergence of the offer sequence (reaching agreement when the counterparty's reservation value permits), and high negotiation utility. Evaluated on 3,000 synthetic bilateral negotiations, our mechanism reduces adversarial inference accuracy by 43-50% while maintaining a negotiation success rate and utility above 90%, demonstrating that strong privacy guarantees can be achieved without significant loss of performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于自主谈判代理中的行为隐私泄露问题。在保险、采购等高风险场景中，谈判代理广泛部署，虽然密码学技术能保护显式披露的约束值，但无法抵御一种更隐蔽的威胁：行为隐私泄露。即攻击者通过观察谈判过程中的让步轨迹、时机和收敛模式等可观测行为，推断代理的私有约束。本文形式化了这一威胁，并提出一种自适应随机谈判策略，该策略能够联合保证(ε,δ)-差分隐私、出价序列的几乎必然收敛（在对手保留价允许时达成协议），以及高谈判效用。在3000个合成双边谈判上的实验表明，该机制将对抗性推理准确率降低了43-50%，同时谈判成功率和效用维持在90%以上，证明强隐私保证可以在不显著牺牲性能的情况下实现。该工作为自主谈判系统的隐私保护提供了理论基础和实用方法，适合隐私计算、多智能体系统及安全协议设计的研究者阅读。

items.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
items.summary: Poisoning attacks against public datasets lead to major concerns, such as (i) misclassification of perceived objects when the poisoned data is used for training and (ii) embedding of backdoors that may eventually be triggered later on, when specific conditions in the system apply over the learned models. Its impact over data augmentation models is unclear. While data augmentation reduces the likelihood of poisoning attack success, some valid questions remain. Is data augmentation affecting the impact of poisoning attacks? can it increase the number of poisoned samples or injected backdoors? We explore in this paper some of these questions. We assess the effects of augmenting poisoned 3D point cloud datasets and validate that poisoning is able to evade the sanitizing nature of augmentation techniques when using the concrete case of Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) techniques to exemplify the case of data augmentation processing. We also validate that poisoning propagates over the augmented datasets and perturbs the decision made by general-purpose classifiers, in the end. All the experimental material (including tools, datasets, and classifiers) is publicly available, to facilitate reproducibility and to foster further research in the topic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了针对增强3D点云公共数据集的投毒攻击在互联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）背景下的操作影响。投毒攻击通过在训练数据中注入恶意样本，可能导致感知对象误分类或埋下后门，在特定条件下触发。然而，数据增强技术（如GAN）虽然通常被认为可以净化数据，但其对投毒攻击的影响尚不明确。本文通过实验评估了在3D点云数据集上应用数据增强（使用GAN生成合成点云）后，投毒攻击是否仍能保持有效性。作者构建了投毒数据集，并使用通用分类器（如PointNet、PointNet++等）进行训练和测试。实验结果表明，投毒攻击能够规避数据增强的去毒化作用，污染样本在后增强数据集中仍能传播，并最终影响分类器的决策。关键发现是：数据增强并不能有效消除投毒影响，反而可能因生成额外样本而扩大污染范围。论文公开了所有实验材料（工具、数据集、分类器）以促进可重复性和进一步研究。该研究主要面向自动驾驶安全、机器学习安全领域的研究人员和工程师，揭示了现有数据增强策略在防御投毒攻击方面的局限性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了数据增强无法有效防御3D点云数据投毒攻击，对依赖公共数据集训练感知模型的自动驾驶系统构成潜在威胁，需重新评估数据流水线的安全性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响自动驾驶车辆中基于3D点云的感知模型训练过程，可能导致模型被植入后门或误分类，危及行车安全。该研究也适用于其他使用3D点云的领域（如机器人、工业检测）。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，建议自动驾驶安全团队评估自身数据增强流程对投毒攻击的鲁棒性，并考虑引入防御性蒸馏或异常检测机制。

items.title: Lower Bounds for PIR with Preprocessing from Blackbox Cryptography
items.summary: (shortened for arXiv metadata) We study the limits of single-server private information retrieval (PIR) with preprocessing. Prior work has shown that single-server PIR with sublinear communication requires a linear number of (public-key) server operations per query [DMO00, DH24]. Recent breakthrough works, including [CHK22, ZPZS24, LMW23], circumvent these lower bounds by critically leveraging preprocessing to construct single-server PIR with sublinear query computation. Our work presents computation lower bounds for any single-server PIR with preprocessing that makes blackbox usage of {\em any} cryptography (such as random oracles and virtual blackbox obfuscation). For any client preprocessing scheme where the client stores $s$ bits about an $n$-bit database, we prove the online amortized computation must be $Ω(n/s)$ across $k = Ω(s)$ queries (even if performed in a single batch query). In more detail, we prove that they must have either $Ω(n/s)$ amortized online communication or the server must perform $Ω(n/s)$ cryptographic operations. Our lower bounds are optimal as there exist PIRs with client preprocessing matching exactly one of the above requirements while outperforming the other. Furthermore, our lower bounds also rule out the existence of doubly efficient PIR from blackbox cryptography with sublinear query computation. Our proof framework also supports $Ω(n/s)$ communication lower bounds for three mildly restricted classes of single-server PIR. We also prove lower bounds for symmetric private information retrieval (SPIR) with client preprocessing in the random oracle model and present a matching SPIR construction with client preprocessing using only OWFs during queries.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究单服务器私有信息检索（PIR）在客户端预处理场景下的计算下界。传统的PIR下界表明，若通信量亚线性，则服务器查询操作数必须与数据库大小n呈线性关系（即Ω(n)）。近年来的突破性工作（如CHK22、ZPZS24、LMW23）通过预处理规避了该下界，实现了亚线性查询计算。然而，本文证明了在客户端存储s比特关于n比特数据库的预处理信息下，任何对密码学原语（如随机预言机、虚拟黑盒混淆）进行黑盒使用的单服务器PIR方案，其在线摊销计算量必须为Ω(n/s)，即使所有k=Ω(s)次查询被组合为批量查询。具体而言，方案要么具有Ω(n/s)的在线摊销通信量，要么服务器必须执行Ω(n/s)次密码学操作。该下界是最优的，因为存在匹配其中一项要求而超越另一项的预处理PIR方案。此外，本文的下界还排除了从黑盒密码学构建具有亚线性查询计算的“双高效”PIR的可能性。证明框架还支持对三类温和限制的单服务器PIR给出Ω(n/s)通信下界。最后，在随机预言机模型下，本文证明了带客户端预处理的对称私有信息检索（SPIR）的下界，并给出一个匹配的SPIR构造，该构造在查询阶段仅使用单向函数（OWF）。该工作为PIR预处理方案的理论极限提供了深刻见解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了客户端预处理PIR方案在密码学黑盒使用下的通信与计算权衡下界，为设计更高效的隐私信息检索方案提供了理论基础，对隐私保护技术的研究具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响了PIR预处理方案的设计方向，特别是需要权衡客户端存储与服务器计算；对数据库隐私查询、安全多方计算等领域的效率优化有指导意义。

items.title: The Power of Backdoor Absorption in Community Training
items.summary: Backdoor attacks severely threaten large-scale AI models. When model owners delegate training to external compute providers within a decentralized training paradigm, adversaries can craft stealthy, low-frequency triggers to inject malicious behavior while evading standard audits. Traditionally, detecting these attacks requires a full re-computation of the training steps--a prohibitive overhead that directly contradicts the owner's resource constraints. To address this, we investigate the resilience of continuous optimization dynamics under Byzantine perturbations, where adversaries are forced to compete against a continuous influx of honest updates. Under a threat model where an adversary compromises f out of n total trainers, we quantify the minimum auditing overhead required by the model owner to probabilistically bound the attack success rate. We formalize this injection-absorption dynamic as a Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC). Using this framework, we prove that the success probability of any bounded adversary asymptotically collapses to zero under a defense strategy combining natural absorption, a randomized scheduler, and lazy verification oracle. Empirical results demonstrate significant backdoor suppression with zero utility degradation even when invoking the verification oracle on merely 10% of the total training steps. This approach yields a provably sound and computationally efficient defense for safety-critical AI.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究分布式训练场景中的后门攻击防御问题。在社区训练（Community Training）范式下，模型所有者将训练任务委托给外部计算提供商，可能遭遇恶意节点注入后门触发器。传统检测方法需要完整重算所有训练步骤，计算开销巨大，不符合资源受限的模型所有者需求。作者将后门注入与吸收的动态过程建模为离散时间马尔可夫链（DTMC），并量化了攻击成功概率的上界。他们提出一种结合三种策略的防御方案：自然吸收（honest updates的连续流入迫使恶意更新被稀释）、随机调度（随机选择训练步骤进行验证）以及懒惰验证（仅对部分步骤执行完整性检查）。理论证明，在任意有限攻击者模型下，攻击成功概率渐近收敛到零。实验表明，即使仅对10%的训练步骤调用验证预言机，也能显著抑制后门效果，且不降低模型在正常任务上的性能。该工作为安全关键型AI系统提供了一种理论上可靠且计算高效的防御方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为分布式训练中的后门攻击提供了一种理论和实践兼顾的低开销防御方案，有助于保护大模型安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接适用于联邦学习、去中心化训练等场景；验证策略可迁移至其他需要轻量级审计的机器学习流水线。

items.title: Generalized Synthetic Image Detection with Enhanced RGB-Noise Representation Learning
items.summary: The rapid advancement of large-scale generative models has accelerated the spread of highly deceptive AI-generated images, making generalized synthetic image detection a critical imperative. Existing forensic networks often struggle with cross-model generalization and realworld degradations due to their reliance on single-domain representations and conventional binary classification optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose RNSIDNet, a novel forensic framework that achieves robust detection through enhanced RGB-Noise representation learning. Specifically, our method employs a dual-branch architecture where global RGB semantics, extracted by an attention-refined CLIP backbone, dynamically modulate highfrequency noise artifacts captured by Bayar convolutions via a Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) module. To further enhance the learned representations, we design a Hard Sample-aware Contrastive Learning (HSCL) strategy. By explicitly penalizing challenging training samples, HSCL reshapes the latent feature space to maximize the discriminative margin between pristine and synthetic domains. Extensive experiments across eight public benchmark datasets verify that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering superior generalization ability, robustness, and computational efficiency. Code and dataset will be publicly available on https://github.com/multimediaFor/RNSIDNet.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大规模生成模型导致的AI生成图像泛滥问题，提出了一种名为RNSIDNet的通用合成图像检测框架。现有取证网络往往依赖单一域表示和传统的二元分类优化，导致跨模型泛化能力和真实世界退化场景下的鲁棒性不足。为了克服这些局限，RNSIDNet采用双分支架构：一个分支通过注意力优化的CLIP骨干网络提取全局RGB语义特征，另一个分支使用Bayar卷积捕获高频噪声伪影，并通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）模块动态融合两者。此外，作者设计了难样本感知对比学习（HSCL）策略，通过显式惩罚困难训练样本，重塑潜在特征空间以最大化真实与合成域之间的判别边界。在八个公开基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该模型在泛化能力、鲁棒性和计算效率方面均达到最先进水平。代码和数据集将开源。

items.title: Dithered Gaussian Mechanism for Randomness-Efficient Differential Privacy
items.summary: We present the dithered Gaussian mechanism, a novel alternative to the discrete Gaussian mechanism for differential privacy that discretizes the private output rather than the noise distribution itself. By interpreting this discretization as post-processing of the Gaussian mechanism, our construction directly inherits the privacy guarantees of the standard Gaussian mechanism while avoiding vulnerabilities caused by finite-precision floating-point outputs. We show that the mechanism is provably randomness-efficient: by sampling the discretized output values directly, the number of high-quality random bits required for privacy can be reduced significantly and made independent of the noise level. This is achieved by separating the randomness into two sources: a high-quality source used for the privacy-critical sampling step, and a high-performance public source, possibly known to the adversary, that supplies the additional randomness needed for randomized discretization. This separation enables the use of cryptographically secure randomness without substantial performance loss. As an application, we study model training with DP-SGD and show that cryptographically secure noise generation with reduced exposure to floating-point vulnerabilities can be achieved with modest practical overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“抖动高斯机制”（Dithered Gaussian Mechanism）的新型差分隐私机制，作为离散高斯机制的替代方案。传统离散高斯机制通过离散化噪声分布来实现隐私保护，但容易受到浮点数精度漏洞的影响。本文的核心创新在于对私有输出进行离散化，而非噪声分布本身。通过将这种离散化视为高斯机制的后处理步骤，该机制直接继承了标准高斯机制的隐私保证，同时避免了有限精度浮点数输出带来的安全漏洞。此外，该机制在随机性效率方面有显著优势：通过直接采样离散化输出值，用于隐私保护的高质量随机比特数量可以大幅减少，且与噪声水平无关。具体来说，该机制将随机性分为两个来源：高质量随机源用于隐私关键的采样步骤，以及高性能公开随机源（可能被对手知晓）用于提供随机离散化所需的额外随机性。这种分离使得使用加密安全的随机性成为可能，而不会显著损失性能。作为应用示例，本文研究了使用DP-SGD（差分隐私随机梯度下降）进行模型训练的场景，结果表明，通过减少浮点数漏洞的暴露，使用加密安全的噪声生成可以以适度的实际开销实现。该论文的主要贡献在于提出了一种兼具随机性高效性和浮点安全性的新机制，为差分隐私在机器学习中的应用提供了更实用的噪声生成方案。适合对差分隐私、安全机器学习、密码学随机性优化感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该机制解决了差分隐私实现中浮点数精度漏洞和随机性消耗大的双重问题，为实际部署DP-SGD等算法提供了更安全高效的噪声生成方案，尤其适合需要加密安全随机性的场景。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升差分隐私库（如TensorFlow Privacy）中噪声生成的安全性与效率，可迁移至任何依赖离散高斯机制的隐私保护机器学习系统。

items.title: Claimed or Attested? A Commit-Signature Dataset and Identity Trust Tiers across the World of Code
items.summary: An author string in a git commit is free text the committer typed, so identity resolution over a global commit corpus rests on a claim that nothing in the commit verifies. A cryptographically signed commit is different: it binds the commit to a key the committer controls, and when that key ties back to a real-world identity the git identity becomes attested rather than merely claimed. We release the first commit-signature axis for the World of Code (WoC), extracted for the V2604 collection. The signature travels in the commit object's gpgsig header and is already carried, unparsed, in the commit-message field of the WoC commit tables, so the axis is a scan over existing tables rather than a re-read of the object database. Over the V2604 corpus of 5,866,595,698 commits, 17.59% carry a signature (PGP dominant at 98.96%, with a growing minority of SSH and X.509/sigstore signatures), or 1,031,721,316 signed commits. We release the per-commit signature map c2sigFull, a key-to-author graph gated so that shared organization and continuous-integration keys are separated from person keys, and A2trust, a per-identity attestation tier (unsigned, signed, real-world-bound, cross-corpus attested) that extends the published A2cls identity-class dataset. The signature axis is a precision anchor, not a coverage layer: signed commits skew toward recent and security-conscious developers, a population that overlaps the scholarly authors a bibliography join targets. We use the person keys to build a cryptographically grounded alias gold that calibrates the heuristic WoC alias map independently of hand-labeled pairs, and to attach an attestation provenance to science-to-software identity links. All artifacts are released as a self-contained, in dependently hosted replication package keyed to the WoC V2604 collection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文发布于arXiv，由Audris Mockus撰写，聚焦于全球代码库（World of Code, WoC）中Git提交的身份验证问题。在Git中，提交的作者字符串是自由文本，无法验证，因此基于全球提交语料库的身份识别依赖于未经证实的声明。而密码学签名提交则不同：它将提交与提交者控制的密钥绑定，当该密钥与真实世界身份关联时，Git身份就从“声称”变为“证明”。作者发布了首个面向WoC的提交签名轴（commit-signature axis），基于V2604集合提取。签名位于提交对象的gpgsig头部，在WoC提交表的提交消息字段中已携带（未解析），因此该轴是对现有表的扫描，而非重新读取对象数据库。在V2604语料库的5,866,595,698次提交中，17.59%带有签名（其中PGP占98.96%，SSH和X.509/sigstore签名比例逐渐增长），共计1,031,721,316次签名提交。作者发布了三个数据集：1）每提交签名映射c2sigFull；2）密钥到作者图gated，用于将共享组织和持续集成密钥与个人密钥分离；3）A2trust，一个基于身份的证据层级（未签名、已签名、真实世界绑定、跨语料库证明），扩展了已发布的A2cls身份类别数据集。签名轴是精度锚点而非覆盖层：签名提交偏向近期且具有安全意识的开发者，这些人群体与学术作者（参考文献连接的目标）重叠。作者使用个人密钥构建了一个密码学基础的金标准别名集，用以独立于手动标记对来校准启发式WoC别名映射，并为科学到软件的身份链接附上证据来源。所有工件作为独立、自包含的复制包发布，密钥与WoC V2604集合对应。该研究为开源软件供应链中的身份验证提供了新的数据基础和方法。

items.title: Poster: Mind the Gap -- Characterizing the Temporal Blind Spot Between GSB and DNS Resolution
items.summary: Google Safe Browsing (GSB) and DNS resolution operate concurrently during browser navigation, yet their packet-level synchronization remains understudied. This work characterizes the timing gap (\(Δ_{time}\)) between GSB-related query close events and parallel DNS resolution responses, identifying a consistent temporal offset with potential security relevance. Using packet-capture analysis across general and CNAME-domain datasets, we observe positive timing gaps in approximately 79\% of measurements. In these instances, DNS responses lag behind GSB-related query closures with median delays of 67-79 ms and maximum delays surpassing 2,400 ms. These empirical results highlight a measurable window within the browsing workflow. We suggest that such temporal inconsistencies, particularly in complex CNAME-domain resolutions, may create a security-relevant timing precondition under DNS-manipulation threat models. These results provide a foundation for further research into timing-based risks and mitigations in browser safety mechanisms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究通过数据包捕获分析，系统性地研究了Google Safe Browsing（GSB）与DNS解析之间的时间同步问题。在浏览器导航过程中，GSB查询和DNS解析是并行进行的，但两者之间的数据包级同步尚未被充分研究。作者定义了时间差Δ_time，即GSB相关查询关闭事件与并行DNS解析响应之间的时间偏移，并发现了一致的时序偏移现象。实验基于一般数据集和CNAME域名数据集，结果显示约79%的测量中存在正时间差（即DNS响应晚于GSB查询关闭），中位延迟在67-79毫秒之间，最大延迟超过2400毫秒。这些实证结果表明，在浏览器工作流程中存在一个可测量的时间窗口。作者指出，这种时间不一致性，特别是在复杂的CNAME域名解析中，可能在DNS操纵威胁模型下产生安全相关的时间前提条件。该研究为浏览器安全机制中的时间相关风险及其缓解措施提供了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了GSB与DNS解析之间的时间盲区，可能被攻击者利用进行定时攻击，绕过安全检测。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖GSB的浏览器安全机制，可能被用于在安全检查完成前执行恶意操作。

items.title: 6G Sensing Security: Distributed Game-Theoretic RL for Urban Beamforming and Attacker Detection
items.summary: In next-generation networks, communication systems will no longer be limited to data transmission and will be expected to acquire awareness of the surrounding environment. This leads to the concept of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), where the same wireless infrastructure is used for both communication and environmental sensing. Thus, ISAC enables the system to transmit information efficiently and observe and interpret channel variations and user behavior. Motivated by this capability, this work focuses on detecting an active attacker in an urban environment scenario, where the attacker intentionally manipulates beamforming directions to increase interference and mislead the transmitter into allocating the main lobe of beam toward itself instead of legitimate users. We apply game-theoretic approaches to model the interaction between legitimate users and the attacker, and integrate the resulting utility-based formulation into a reinforcement learning (RL) framework. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses security challenges in dynamic 6G ISAC systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对下一代6G网络中的集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统面临的安全挑战展开研究。在ISAC架构中，通信与感知功能共享同一无线基础设施，系统不仅能高效传输数据，还能感知周围环境、观测信道变化和用户行为。然而，这种能力也引入了新的攻击面：攻击者可能故意操纵波束成形方向，增加干扰并误导发射器将主瓣指向自身而非合法用户，从而实施主动攻击。为了检测此类攻击，作者提出了一种基于博弈论的分布式强化学习（RL）方法。首先，通过博弈论模型刻画合法用户与攻击者之间的互动，将双方的目标形式化为效用函数；然后，将该效用驱动的优化问题嵌入到RL框架中，使得各分布式节点能够通过学习最优策略来实现攻击检测。仿真结果表明，所提方法能够动态适应城市环境中的信号变化，有效识别恶意波束操纵行为，在保证通信质量的同时提升了6G ISAC系统的安全性。本研究为未来的无线安全防御提供了新颖的理论工具，并展示了博弈RL在复杂电磁环境下的应用潜力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 6G ISAC系统是下一代移动通信的关键方向，其感知-通信融合特性带来了新的安全威胁。本文首次将博弈论与强化学习相结合来检测主动波束操纵攻击，为网络安全从业者提供了前沿的防御思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可推广至其他动态无线网络（如车联网、无人机通信）中针对波束成形或资源分配的欺骗攻击检测场景。

items.title: A Dual-CRDT Architecture for Decentralized Trust Governance and Evolution
items.summary: While CRDTs provide decentralized replication and eventual consistency, Byzantine-resilient deployments require mechanisms for deciding which updates should be trusted and therefore contribute to the reconstructed state. In practice, the trust relationships underlying these decisions may evolve over time as participants join or leave, identities change, and governance rules are revised. However, the information used to make trust decisions is typically managed outside the replicated state itself. This paper introduces a dual-CRDT architecture composed of a \emph{Trust CRDT} and a \emph{Data CRDT}. The Trust CRDT stores and evolves governance information, while the Data CRDT is reconstructed according to the trust configuration derived from the Trust CRDT. Governance therefore becomes replicated state rather than an externally managed artifact. Building upon deterministic reconstruction and Byzantine trust filtering, the proposed model allows trust relationships and governance rules to evolve through ordinary CRDT updates. The resulting architecture provides a recursive governance model in which governance rules determine their own future evolution while simultaneously governing application data. The approach is implemented as a prototype on top of Melda and melda-sec and should be viewed as an initial exploration of decentralized trust governance and evolution for Byzantine-resilient CRDT systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种双CRDT（无冲突复制数据类型）架构，用于实现去中心化系统中的信任治理与演化。在Byzantine容错的CRDT部署中，需要决定哪些更新可被信任并贡献于状态重建，而信任关系会随时间变化（如参与者加入/离开、身份变更、治理规则修改）。传统方法将信任决策信息独立于复制状态管理，导致治理不灵活。作者设计了Trust CRDT和Data CRDT两个组件：Trust CRDT存储并演化治理信息（如信任关系、规则），Data CRDT根据Trust CRDT导出的信任配置重建状态。通过确定性重建和Byzantine信任过滤，信任和规则可通过常规CRDT更新动态演化，形成递归治理模型——治理规则既决定自身未来演化，又控制应用数据。该架构在Melda和melda-sec基础上实现了原型，是对Byzantine容错CRDT系统去中心化信任治理的初步探索。论文贡献在于将治理作为复制状态而非外部管理对象，提升了系统的自治性和灵活性。适合分布式系统、区块链、去中心化应用领域的研究者和工程师阅读，尤其关注Byzantine容错和信任管理问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为去中心化系统提供了将信任治理内化于复制状态的机制，解决了传统方案无法动态调整信任规则的痛点，对Byzantine容错CRDT的实际部署具有理论指导意义。

items.title: REAN: Reconstruction-aware ECG Anonymization Based on Privacy--Utility Orthogonality
items.summary: A shared electrocardiogram (ECG) is itself a biometric fingerprint that can re-identify a patient and reveal personal information. Recent ECG anonymizers transform the signal before sharing to reduce privacy leakage. However, existing methods still face a privacy--utility trade-off, in which preserving privacy often compromises utility while preserving utility reveals personal information. We propose \emph{REAN} (\emph{RE}construction-aware ECG \emph{AN}onymizer), a raw ECG signal anonymizer, to address this privacy--utility trade-off. REAN reconstructs the signal using a 1-D U-Net trained with losses from frozen privacy and utility classifiers to reduce privacy leakage while preserving utility. The privacy and utility gradients are near-orthogonal ($\approx$93.8$^\circ$), so reducing privacy leakage leaves utility almost unchanged. On four public PhysioNet databases, REAN achieves the strongest privacy--utility balance among raw ECG signal baselines. It drives re-identification to chance (0.96$\to$0.00), keeps arrhythmia macro-AUROC at the clean level (Clean 0.9982 vs.\ REAN 0.9991), and maintains re-identification protection under unseen privacy-classifier architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为REAN（Reconstruction-aware ECG Anonymizer）的心电图（ECG）原始信号匿名化方法。ECG信号本身具有生物特征指纹特性，共享ECG可能导致患者重识别和隐私泄露。现有匿名化方法面临隐私-效用权衡：提升隐私保护往往降低效用（如疾病诊断精度），而维持效用则无法有效保护隐私。REAN通过1维U-Net网络重构信号，训练时引入冻结的隐私分类器（用于度量个人信息泄露）和效用分类器（用于度量诊断任务性能）的损失，以在减少隐私泄露的同时保留效用。关键创新在于发现隐私和效用的梯度近似正交（约93.8°），因此降低隐私泄露几乎不影响效用。在四个公开PhysioNet数据库上的实验表明，REAN实现了原始ECG信号基线中最强的隐私-效用平衡：重识别准确率从0.96降至0（接近随机猜测），心律失常宏AUROC保持与干净信号相当（原始0.9982 vs REAN 0.9991），并且对未见过的隐私分类器架构也具有鲁棒性。该工作为医疗生物特征数据共享中的隐私保护提供了新思路，适合隐私保护机器学习、医疗数据安全领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ECG作为生物特征指纹，共享可能泄露患者身份和健康信息，该研究提出一种梯度正交思想，可有效缓解隐私-效用权衡，为类似生物特征匿名化问题提供可迁移方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响医疗数据共享、可穿戴设备隐私保护、以及生物特征匿名化领域；方法可迁移到其他一维信号（如肌电图、脑电图）匿名化。

items.title: ProvICS: A Provenance-based Intrusion Detection for Industrial Control Systems
items.summary: The convergence of Information Technology and Operational Technology has exposed Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to multi-stage cyberattacks that traverse software, network, and physical process layers simultaneously. Although Provenance-based Intrusion Detection Systems (PIDS) are effective in Information Technology (IT) environments, their applicability to Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) remains largely unexplored because of the absence of datasets that jointly capture host-level causal behavior, industrial network semantics, and physical process state. To address this gap, we design an open-source, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) CPS testbed that replicates an industrial chemical reactor control architecture across the Purdue model layers. Using this testbed, we propose ProvICS, a multimodal provenance dataset purpose-built for CPS intrusion detection, which synchronously captures four streams: whole-system provenance graphs from the supervisory host and the resource-constrained PLC, decoded Modbus deep-packet inspection records, and physical process telemetry. The collection comprises a 48-hour benign phase and a 22-hour attack phase across four campaigns covering 20 ICS ATT&CK techniques over 32 attack events, ranging from reconnaissance to physical process manipulation. Comparative analysis shows that ProvICS is among the few existing ICS/CPS benchmarks with multi-host kernel-level provenance, real PLC hardware-in-the-loop execution, decoded Modbus traffic, physical process-state measurements, and auxiliary raw PCAP traces in a time-synchronized collection. Baseline detection further confirms that cross-modal fusion can detect all 32 labeled attack events (F1 = 0.913, false-positive rate (FPR) = 1.40%), demonstrating the dataset's ability to expose complementary attack signals across modalities and addressing a gap not covered by prior benchmarks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对信息技术（IT）与运营技术（OT）融合导致工业控制系统（ICS）面临跨软件、网络和物理过程的多阶段网络攻击问题，提出了一种基于溯源的入侵检测数据集 ProvICS。现有基于溯源的入侵检测系统（PIDS）在IT环境中效果显著，但由于缺乏同时捕获主机级因果行为、工业网络语义和物理过程状态的数据集，其在工业网络物理系统（CPS）中的应用尚不充分。为此，作者设计了一个开源的硬件在环（HIL）CPS测试平台，模拟工业化学反应器控制架构，覆盖Purdue模型各层。利用该平台，提出了ProvICS多模态溯源数据集，同步采集四类数据：来自监控主机和资源受限PLC的全系统溯源图、解码的Modbus深度包检测记录、物理过程遥测数据。数据集包含48小时正常阶段和22小时攻击阶段，覆盖4个攻击战役、20种ICS ATT&CK技术、32个攻击事件（从侦察到物理过程操纵）。对比分析表明，ProvICS是少数提供多主机内核级溯源、真实PLC硬件在环、解码Modbus流量、物理过程状态测量及原始PCAP轨迹且时间同步的ICS/CPS基准数据集。基线检测实验表明，跨模态融合可检测全部32个标记攻击事件（F1=0.913，误报率1.40%），证明数据集能暴露跨模态的互补攻击信号，弥补了现有基准的空白。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为ICS环境下的多模态溯源入侵检测提供了首个公开的硬件在环数据集，填补了IT溯源方法向CPS迁移的数据空白，有助于蓝队和安全研究者开发更有效的跨层攻击检测方案。

items.title: From Regression to Prior-Aware Inference: Solving the ILWE Family in Randomness Leakage Attacks against ML-DSA
items.summary: ML-DSA is a representative lattice-based signature scheme standardized by NIST. It relies on signing randomness and rejection sampling to ensure that released signatures are statistically independent of the secret key. Practical implementations, however, may leak partial information about this randomness, and such leakage can transform public signatures into ILWE-type problems, resulting in secret key disclosure risks. Such randomness leakage attack can be formulated as a two-stage key-recovery procedure, in which leaked partial information and public signatures are first transformed into an ILWE-family instance, and then a recovery solver is applied to recover the secret key. Existing work has mainly focused on the first stage by constructing such instances under different leakage models. By contrast, the role of solver in the subsequent instance-solving stage remains under-explored, and existing attacks often rely on ad-hoc model-specific solvers. To address this gap, we propose a unified framework to systematically evaluate different recovery solvers on leakage-derived ILWE-family instances. The framework covers three ILWE instances, including the ordinary ILWE, Fiat-Shamir ILWE (FS-ILWE) and Concealed ILWE (CILWE) under different scenarios. Within our framework, we explore three classes of solvers. Our experiments show that the solver has a significant impact on the secret-key recovery efficiency. In particular, on FS-ILWE, prior-aware discrete-inference reduces the number of informative relations by one to two orders of magnitude compared to the baselines: Compared with OLS, BP constitutes a reduction by a factor of 15.4x-64.9x in noise-free settings, and by a factor of 10.5x-73.9x in noisy settings. Overall, this work provides a systematic evaluation on different solvers in randomness leakage attacks, and presents new benchmarks for future analysis on ML-DSA.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统研究了针对 NIST 标准化格基签名方案 ML-DSA 的随机性泄露攻击中的求解器问题。ML-DSA 的安全性依赖于签名随机性和拒绝抽样来保证签名与密钥统计独立，但实际实现可能泄露部分随机性信息，导致公开签名转化为 ILWE（Inhomogeneous Learning With Errors）类型问题，进而可能恢复密钥。此类攻击通常分为两阶段：首先利用泄露信息构建 ILWE 实例，然后通过求解器恢复密钥。现有工作多关注第一阶段的不同泄露模型，而求解器阶段缺乏系统研究，且攻击常依赖特定模型的定制求解器。为此，本文提出了一个统一框架，用于评估不同求解器在多种 ILWE 实例上的性能，涵盖普通 ILWE、Fiat-Shamir ILWE（FS-ILWE）和隐匿 ILWE（CILWE）。框架内考虑了三类求解器：普通最小二乘法（OLS）、信念传播（BP）和先验感知离散推理（PADI）。实验表明，求解器对密钥恢复效率影响显著。在 FS-ILWE 上，PADI 将所需的信息关系数量减少了一到两个数量级；与 OLS 相比，BP 在无噪声环境下减少了 15.4 至 64.9 倍，在有噪声环境下减少了 10.5 至 73.9 倍。本文为 ML-DSA 随机性泄露攻击中的求解器选择提供了系统评估和新的基准，对后量子密码实现的安全性分析具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文首次系统评估了 ML-DSA 随机性泄露攻击中求解器对密钥恢复效率的影响，揭示了先验感知离散推理等先进方法可显著降低攻击所需信息量，对评估和防御此类侧信道攻击有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响评估: 论文本身是学术研究，不直接涉及在野利用；但为侧信道攻击者提供了更高效的密钥恢复方法，可能降低实际攻击的门槛。若 ML-DSA 实现存在随机性泄露，攻击者可通过更少的泄露信息完成密钥恢复。

items.title: LibFHE: A Numba-Based CUDA-Python Library for Non-RNS CKKS-BGV Fully Homomorphic Encryption on GPUs
items.summary: It has been a decade since the fourth-generation FHE framework, CKKS, was proposed; yet, there is still no indicator pointing toward a fifth-generation successor; and in recent years, numerous studies have explored GPU acceleration to improve the efficiency of homomorphic computations. In this paper, we propose LibFHE, a high-performance GPU-accelerated framework that features CUDA-Python bindings to achieve both high-level programmability and bare-metal GPU performance for homomorphic workloads. A large majority of state-of-the-art implementations adopt the RNS-CKKS variant. In contrast, this work deliberately revisits the original (non-RNS) CKKS-BGV framework, and develops a GPU-based implementation along with corresponding optimizations. Experimental results demonstrate that optimized CUDA-Python implementations can achieve performance comparable to highly optimized CPU-based C++ FHE libraries, while significantly reducing implementation complexity and improving programmability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出名为LibFHE的高性能GPU加速全同态加密（FHE）框架，采用CUDA-Python绑定，结合Numba即时编译技术，在保证高级可编程性的同时实现接近裸金属的GPU性能。作者指出，自CKKS方案提出十年来，尚无第五代FHE继任者，而近年来众多研究聚焦GPU加速以提高同态计算效率。与主流采用RNS-CKKS变体的工作不同，LibFHE刻意回归原始的（非RNS）CKKS-BGV框架，并开发了GPU实现及相应优化。实验表明，优化后的CUDA-Python实现可达到与高度优化的CPU端C++ FHE库相当的性能，同时显著降低实现复杂度、提升可编程性。该工作为FHE的实用化部署提供了新途径，尤其适用于需要保护隐私的大规模数据计算场景，如云计算、医疗数据分析、金融隐私保护等。论文详细描述了库的设计、优化策略（包括内存管理、并行调度等）以及性能对比结果，证实了GPU加速FHE的可行性和优势。

items.title: PRoVeFL: Private Robust and Verifiable Aggregation in Federated Learning
items.summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train machine learning models while retaining data locality, thereby enhancing user privacy. However, traditional FL frameworks rely on a centralized aggregation server and assume honest-but-curious clients, making them susceptible to both server-side inference and client-side poisoning attacks. Although recent work has explored secure and Byzantine-resilient FL protocols, they face a fundamental trade-off among privacy, integrity, and verifiability, and incur substantial computational and communication overhead due to the heavy use of cryptographic primitives. In this work, we propose PRoVeFL-a novel, modular FL framework that is Privacy-preserving, Byzantine-Robust, and ensures Verifiable aggregation. PRoVeFL employs multiple servers leveraging multi-key fully homomorphic encryption. Each client encrypts its local model updates and distributes encrypted shares to all servers. This design enables a hybrid computation model in which ciphertext operations are carefully offloaded to the plaintext domain under strict privacy constraints to efficiently evaluate complex statistical aggregation rules. PRoVeFL is compatible with a wide range of state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust aggregation algorithms (e.g., Krum, Trimmed Mean, FLTrust, norm clipping, MESAS, and more) and further enhances them with verifiability mechanisms that require minimal trust in at least one honest server. We evaluate it across different settings and demonstrate its scalability with varying numbers of parameters and participants. PRoVeFL improves runtime over the prior works, Prio and ELSA, based on distributed trust with comparable security guarantees, up to 100x and 10x, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）允许多个客户端在保持数据本地性的同时协作训练机器学习模型，从而增强用户隐私。然而，传统FL框架依赖于中心化聚合服务器，并假设客户端是诚实但好奇的，这使其容易受到服务器端推理和客户端投毒攻击。尽管近期工作探索了安全且拜占庭鲁棒的FL协议，但它们在隐私、完整性和可验证性之间存在根本性权衡，并且由于大量使用密码学原语而导致计算和通信开销巨大。本文提出PRoVeFL——一种新颖的模块化FL框架，同时具备隐私保护、拜占庭鲁棒性和可验证聚合能力。PRoVeFL使用多个服务器，利用多密钥全同态加密。每个客户端加密其本地模型更新，并将加密份额分发给所有服务器。这种设计实现了混合计算模型，在严格隐私约束下将密文操作精心卸载到明文域，以高效评估复杂的统计聚合规则。PRoVeFL兼容多种最先进的拜占庭鲁棒聚合算法（如Krum、Trimmed Mean、FLTrust、范数裁剪、MESAS等），并通过可验证性机制进一步增强这些算法，该机制仅需信任至少一个诚实服务器。我们在不同设置下评估了PRoVeFL，并展示了其在参数和参与者数量变化时的可扩展性。与基于分布式信任的先前工作Prio和ELSA相比，PRoVeFL在具有可比安全保证的情况下，运行时间分别提升高达100倍和10倍。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文解决了联邦学习中隐私、鲁棒性和可验证性难以兼得的瓶颈，提出的PRoVeFL框架在性能上大幅超越现有方案，为构建实际可部署的安全联邦学习系统提供了重要技术路径。安全从业者可借此设计更安全、高效的跨机构协作学习方案。

items.title: Reproducible Validation of Voucher-Based L2 Interoperability: Diagnosing an ERC-4337 Compatibility Issue in an EIL SDK Implementation
items.summary: Ethereum Layer-2 (L2) ecosystems improve scalability but also fragment users, liquidity, gas funding, and execution across rollups. Consequently, cross-rollup interoperability is not only a bridging problem but also a wallet, execution, and validation problem. Ethereum Interop Layer (EIL) proposes a voucher-based architecture in which users create voucher requests on an origin chain and redeem XLP-signed vouchers on a destination chain. When reproducing the evaluated SDK version in a controlled local environment, we observed a compatibility issue in the \texttt{UserOperation} path: paymaster-related data can differ after signing, preventing a stable comparison between the user-authorized representation and the representation later inspected by the local validation flow. This paper presents a reproducible two-L2 validation framework and a controlled compatibility mitigation for that issue. We build a deterministic local testbed over Arbitrum- and Optimism-style development chains, deploy the core paymaster and bridge-related components, implement mock bundlers and event-driven XLP providers, and introduce a sanitized paymaster-data handling path together with a compatible multichain account wrapper. Using this framework, we execute the core voucher lifecycle from request creation to destination-chain voucher redemption and asset release. The contribution is an empirical diagnosis of an implementation-level compatibility barrier, a bounded mitigation that restores controlled end-to-end execution, and an inspectable validation artifact for studying voucher-based interoperability. The work does not claim a new interoperability protocol, universal wallet compatibility, or production readiness; it identifies the remaining gaps toward standard-account validation, one-signature multichain authorization, and full dispute-settlement support.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对以太坊Layer-2（L2）生态系统中跨rollup互操作性的实际问题展开研究。背景是L2虽提升了可扩展性，却导致用户、流动性、Gas费用和执行状态在不同rollup之间碎片化。文章聚焦于以太坊互操作层（EIL）提出的基于凭证（voucher）的架构：用户在源链创建凭证请求，然后在目标链兑换由XLP签名的凭证。在复现评估中的SDK版本时，作者发现了一个与ERC-4337兼容性相关的实现问题：在UserOperation路径中，支付者（paymaster）相关数据在签名后可能发生变化，导致用户授权的表示与本地验证流程检查的表示无法稳定比对。为解决此问题，本文提出一个可复现的双L2验证框架及受控的兼容性缓解方案。具体地，作者在基于Arbitrum和Optimism风格的开发链上构建了确定性本地测试环境，部署了核心支付者和桥接相关组件，实现了模拟打包器（mock bundler）和事件驱动的XLP提供者，并引入了经过清理的支付者数据处理路径以及兼容的多链账户包装器。利用该框架，作者执行了完整的凭证生命周期，从请求创建到目标链凭证兑换和资产释放。贡献包括：对实现级兼容性障碍的经验诊断、恢复受控端到端执行的有限缓解方案，以及用于研究基于凭证互操作性的可检查验证构件。工作未声称新的互操作协议、通用钱包兼容性或生产就绪，但指出了标准账户验证、单签名多链授权和完整争议解决支持方面的剩余差距。适合以太坊L2开发者、钱包实现者和互操作性研究人员阅读。

items.title: Auditing of Unlearning Algorithms
items.summary: Evaluating whether unlearning algorithms truly remove training data influence remains an open challenge. We propose a practical auditor that computes data-dependent lower bounds on the unlearning parameter $\varepsilon$ using membership inference attacks. Evaluating multiple unlearning algorithms, we find a sharp separation: algorithms with rigorous guarantees, such as model clipping and rewind-to-delete, achieve very small $\varepsilon$ bounds that do not falsify their unlearning guarantees, whereas empirical methods such as Hessian-based unlearning, interleaved ascent-descent, ascent on the forget set, and fine-tuning on the retain set exhibit large bounds, indicating poor unlearning. Our auditor provides a practical tool for empirically falsifying unlearning claims through a hypothesis-testing framework, and we validate it on CIFAR-100 and Shakespeare text.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对机器学习模型遗忘算法的有效性评估问题，提出了一种实用的审计方法。遗忘算法旨在从训练好的模型中移除特定训练数据的影响，但如何验证其是否真正实现了遗忘仍是一个开放挑战。作者设计了一个审计器，利用成员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attacks）来计算与遗忘参数ε相关的数据依赖下界。具体而言，审计器通过测试模型对遗忘数据点的记忆程度，给出一个统计下界，若该下界很小则表明遗忘可能有效，否则意味着遗忘不彻底。在CIFAR-100和Shakespeare文本数据集上，作者对多种遗忘算法进行了评估，结果发现存在显著差异：具有严格理论保证的算法（如模型裁剪、回滚删除）表现出非常小的ε下界，验证了其遗忘承诺；而基于经验的方法（如Hessian遗忘、交错上升下降、遗忘集上升、保留集微调）则表现出较大的ε下界，表明遗忘效果不佳。该审计器基于假设检验框架，能够从实证角度驳斥虚假的遗忘声明，为遗忘算法的可信度评估提供了实用工具。论文的主要贡献包括：提出数据依赖的遗忘审计方法、在多个算法上展示其辨别能力，以及为未来遗忘算法的标准化评估奠定基础。适合机器学习安全研究人员、模型审计从业者以及关注隐私保护的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为遗忘算法的可信度评估提供了首个实用的审计方法，能有效区分理论严格与经验性的遗忘算法，对模型隐私保护和合规性验证具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接应用于评估各类遗忘算法的有效性，可推广至联邦学习、数据删除请求（Right to be Forgotten）等场景的合规审计。

items.title: Security and Privacy in Agentic AI: Grand Challenges and Future Directions
items.summary: We present key challenges and future research directions in the security and privacy of agentic AI, based on a horizon-scanning exercise that brought together thirty leading international experts from academia, industry, and government to engage in focused discussions and collaborative exercises on the emerging risks associated with the growing agency of AI.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文基于一项地平线扫描（horizon-scanning）活动，汇集了来自学术界、工业界和政府的三位国际顶尖专家，通过聚焦讨论和协作练习，系统性地识别了代理型人工智能（Agentic AI）在安全与隐私方面的重大挑战和未来研究方向。代理型AI是指具有自主决策和行动能力的人工智能系统，其日益增强的自主性带来了前所未有的安全与隐私风险。论文首先概述了代理型AI的发展现状和核心特征，包括自主性、目标导向性、环境交互性等。然后，专家团队围绕六个关键维度展开讨论：① 权限与身份管理：自主代理可能以超预期方式滥用授权，导致权限提升或横向移动；② 责任归属与可问责性：当代理行为造成损害时，难以确定责任主体（开发者、部署者还是用户）；③ 数据隐私与保护：代理在持续交互中可能收集和处理敏感数据，存在隐私泄露和滥用风险；④ 对抗性鲁棒性：攻击者可能通过操纵输入或环境诱导代理做出危险行为；⑤ 透明性与可解释性：代理的决策过程不透明，阻碍安全审计和故障排查；⑥ 治理与合规：现有法规（如GDPR）对自主代理的适用性不足。论文进一步提出了未来研究方向，包括设计安全优先的代理架构、开发可验证的权限模型、建立跨代理的信任机制、制定针对代理行为的隐私保护技术（如差分隐私、联邦学习在代理场景的扩展），以及通过形式化方法保障代理决策的安全性。本文的主要贡献在于：首次从多学科视角系统梳理了代理型AI安全与隐私的挑战全景，为后续研究提供了路线图；强调了安全与隐私设计应贯穿代理全生命周期，而非事后修补。适合AI安全研究员、隐私工程师、政策制定者以及负责任AI的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 代理型AI的自主性使其安全与隐私风险与传统AI显著不同，本文系统性勾勒了该领域的关键挑战和研究方向，为安全社区提供了前瞻性参考和行动框架。

items.title: MSCENet: A Multi-Scale Correlation Enhanced Network for Anomaly Detection
items.summary: In the field of multivariate time series anomaly detection, against the backdrop of increasing data complexity and complex dependencies across multiple temporal scales, traditional methods often struggle to simultaneously capture temporal dynamic features and intricate inter-series correlations. To address this, we propose an innovative framework, MSCENet, which leverages advanced spatio-temporal learning and multi-scale learning techniques to enhance detection accuracy. MSCENet includes a fine-grained temporal convolution module that captures complex temporal dependencies through dilated convolutions, enabling the detection of both short- and long-term patterns. Additionally, the framework models inter-series relationships as a graph structure, using Mixhop graph convolutions to adaptively capture spatial dependencies across varying time scales. To support robust anomaly detection, the multi-scale gated convolution module in MSCENet integrates spatial and temporal attributes through gated mechanisms, facilitating the detection of subtle variations across multiple scales. Experimental evaluations on real-world datasets: SMD, PSM, and SWaT. It provides an adaptable and high-performance solution for anomaly detection in complex time series data environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 针对多变量时间序列异常检测中数据复杂度增加、跨时间尺度依赖复杂的问题，传统方法难以同时捕获时间动态特征与序列间复杂相关性。为此，本文提出MSCENet框架，通过先进的时空学习与多尺度学习技术提升检测精度。该框架包含三个核心模块：细粒度时间卷积模块利用扩张卷积捕获短时和长时模式；将序列间关系建模为图结构，采用Mixhop图卷积自适应捕获不同时间尺度下的空间依赖；多尺度门控卷积模块通过门控机制融合时空属性，实现多尺度微小变化的检测。实验在SMD、PSM和SWaT三个真实数据集上验证了MSCENet的有效性，表明其能适应复杂时间序列数据环境中的异常检测。论文主要贡献在于提出了一种集成多尺度相关增强的端到端框架，为多变量时间序列异常检测提供了高性能解决方案。适合时间序列异常检测研究者、安全分析师及运维工程师阅读。

items.title: Withdrawability in Fiat-Shamir with aborts constructions
items.summary: This article presents an extension of the work performed by Liu, Baek and Susilo on withdrawable signatures to the Fiat-Shamir with aborts paradigm. We introduce an abstract construction, and provide security proofs for this proposal. As an instantiation, we provide a concrete withdrawable signature scheme based on a no-hint, full-t Dilithium-style Fiat-Shamir with aborts construction; adapting to production ML-DSA (with hints) introduces a small epsilon term.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文扩展了 Liu、Baek 和 Susilo 提出的可撤销签名（withdrawable signatures）概念，将其推广到 Fiat-Shamir with aborts 范式。作者首先给出了一个抽象的构造方案，并提供了完整的安全证明。作为实例化，论文基于无提示（no-hint）、全尺寸 Dilithium 风格的 Fiat-Shamir with aborts 构造，设计了一个具体的可撤销签名方案；当适配生产级 ML-DSA（带提示）时，会引入一个小的 epsilon 项。该研究为后量子签名方案的密钥撤销管理提供了理论支持，但仅限于 abstract 中的描述，缺乏实验验证。

items.title: Unicode TAG-Block Concealment of Tool-Metadata Payloads in the Model Context Protocol: An Approval-View Fidelity Gap Across Three Independent Server Implementations
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the dominant way coding agents discover and invoke external tools. A server advertises each tool through a tools/list handshake that returns a name, a natural-language description, and a JSON input schema. The client renders this metadata once, in a one-time approval dialog, and then injects it verbatim into the model's context on every subsequent turn. Nothing in the protocol requires the rendered approval view and the bytes delivered to the model to match. We isolate that gap as a single structural mechanism, concealment encoding, and show with a model-free, protocol-free analysis that Unicode's TAG block (U+E0000 to U+E007F) has no assigned glyph in any mainstream terminal, chat, or IDE renderer, so a payload written in it is absent from what a human reviewer sees while surviving byte-for-byte into the model's tokenizer. We then measure whether this mechanism actually defeats today's client-side defenses, building a proof-of-concept that speaks the real MCP JSON-RPC/stdio protocol against a genuine client and server. Across 5 distinct MCP metadata surfaces we implement 8 concrete techniques with a deterministic, protocol-level harness. All 8/8 techniques deliver an attacker-controlled payload into the model's context, 4/8 evade a representative string-matching sanitizer, and exactly as the mechanism analysis predicts, only the TAG-block encoding (1/8) is invisible in the human approval view while still reaching the model verbatim. MCP forces re-approval for 0/8 techniques even under a time-of-check to time-of-use rug-pull. To test whether these outcomes are a property of the protocol or an artifact of one server codebase, we re-implement the catalogue against 3 independently developed Python MCP server libraries and find total agreement across all 32 cross-library outcome cells. The baseline sanitizer flags 0 of 25 benign descriptions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究揭示了模型上下文协议（MCP）中的一个安全漏洞：工具元数据在客户端审批视图与注入模型上下文的字节之间可能存在不一致。作者将这种差距定义为“隐藏编码”机制，并聚焦于Unicode TAG块（U+E0000至U+E007F），该块在所有主流终端、聊天或IDE渲染器中均未分配字形，因此人类审查者无法看到用其编写的载荷，但载荷却逐字节进入模型的tokenizer。作者构建了概念验证，使用真实MCP JSON-RPC/stdio协议在5个不同的MCP元数据表面上实现了8种具体技术。所有8种技术都将攻击者控制的载荷送入模型上下文，4种技术绕过了代表性字符串匹配清洗器，而只有TAG块编码（1/8）在人类审批视图中不可见且完整到达模型。MCP在检查时间到使用时间的“抽地毯”攻击下，0/8的技术需要重新审批。为了验证结果是协议属性还是某个服务器代码库的产物，作者在3个独立开发的Python MCP服务器库上重新实现了所有测试，所有32个跨库结果完全一致。基线清洗器对25个良性描述均未标记。该研究表明，MCP的现有防御机制不足以检测此类隐藏载荷，对基于LLM的编码代理的安全构成威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了MCP协议中一个严重的设计缺陷，使得攻击者可以隐藏恶意工具元数据，绕过人类审批，直接注入到模型上下文中。这对依赖MCP的编码代理安全构成直接威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用MCP协议的AI编码代理，可能导致工具调用被劫持、敏感信息泄露或任意代码执行。攻击者可通过隐蔽载荷在用户不知情的情况下操纵模型行为。

items.title: Calibration-Family Overfit: Why Trusted Sabotage Monitors Don't Transfer Across Lineages
items.summary: Trusted monitoring is a central defense in AI control: a cheaper trusted model scores an untrusted model's actions for sabotage, and the most suspicious are audited or deferred. Such monitors are evaluated against one or two untrusted models, and the accuracy is reported as a property of the monitor. We ask whether it is partly a property of the pairing. We make the untrusted policy family the controlled axis: we fit a monitor on family A's transcripts, apply it to family B, and decompose the cross-family AUROC into how obvious each family's sabotage is, how capable each monitor is, and the residual own-family advantage after both are removed: the interaction. On code-backdoor transcripts the interaction is positive and survives the dominant confounds: +0.172 (95% CI [+0.158, +0.185]) on four open-weight families on a strict leak-free basis, holding across an eight-family matrix spanning four frontier vendors, blatancy-matched controls, a trained transcript-reading monitor up to 34B parameters, and a second code benchmark. The gap is geometric: each lineage's sabotage occupies a different scoring direction, and rotating the monitor's scoring direction toward the target lineage recovers most of the lost detection while a matched random rotation recovers nothing. At a 1% audit budget under defer-to-trusted, an off-lineage monitor catches 19% of attack attempts where an in-lineage monitor catches 41% at the same audit cost, a +21.7-point gap. Control evaluations should report cross-family transfer matrices: a single-pairing accuracy overstates the safety a monitor delivers against a lineage it was not calibrated on. We give a four-step protocol that acts on the gap, with each step a measured result.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究AI安全控制中的可信监控（trusted monitoring）防线。可信监控依赖一个更便宜的“可信模型”对“不可信模型”的行为进行评分，以检测潜在的破坏性行为（如后门攻击）。传统评估仅针对一个或两个不可信模型报告准确率，但本文质疑这种准确率是监控器与模型家族的配对属性。作者通过控制不可信策略家族（即模型系列）作为变量，在代码后门攻击场景下，对四个开源权重家族（涵盖四大前沿厂商）进行严格无泄漏的跨家族转移实验。结果表明，监控器在自身家族上表现优异，但跨家族时检测性能显著下降：跨家族AUROC比同家族低0.172（95% CI [0.158, 0.185]），且这一差距在控制后门明显性后依然存在。进一步分析发现，不同家族的破坏行为在特征空间中占据不同的方向，而监控器的评分方向若偏向目标家族，则能恢复大部分损失；随机旋转则无效果。在1%审计预算的“委托-信任”机制下，来自不同家族的监控器仅捕获19%的攻击尝试，而同家族监控器可捕获41%，差距高达21.7个百分点。因此，单配对评估高估了监控器实际部署时的安全性。作者提出四步协议：测量跨家族AUROC矩阵、量化交互效应、检查几何方向、报告同族与异族性能差异。本文适合关注AI安全控制评估方法论的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前可信监控评估中的一个关键盲点：监控器可能过拟合于其校准时的模型家族，导致跨家族部署时安全性被高估。对依赖单一模型对评估的安全架构构成挑战，需引入跨家族验证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用可信监控作为AI安全防线的场景，特别是多模型供应商环境或模型持续更新的场景。评估方法需标准化为跨家族转移矩阵。
